nodes.name: 1. Read Spec JSON
nodes.notes: Reads the spec JSON for the short to build. Set spec_path in the trigger or it defaults to sunrise_guilt.json.

nodes.name: 2. Validate Spec
nodes.notes: Parses the spec, checks that the source video exists, and validates minimum scene count.

nodes.name: 3. Cut & Crop Scenes
nodes.notes: Extracts scenes from the source film, crops/fits to 9:16, and concatenates into a base clip.

nodes.name: 4. Render Final (subtitles + music + voiceover)
nodes.notes: Runs the full spark_shorts.py pipeline: burns subtitles, mixes music with sidechain compression, adds voiceover, outputs final MP4 + metadata.

nodes.name: 5. Verify Output
nodes.notes: Checks that the final MP4 and metadata text file were created, reports file size and metadata preview.
